use magnus::{prelude::*, Error, TryConvert, Value};

fn optional(args: &[Value]) -> Result<Option<String>, Error> {
    let args = magnus::scan_args::scan_args::<(), (Option<Value>,), (), (), (), ()>(args)?;
    let (value,) = args.optional;
    CONVERSION
    Ok(value)
}

#[magnus::init]
fn init(ruby: &magnus::Ruby) -> Result<(), Error> {
    ruby.define_global_function("optional_string_fixture", magnus::function!(optional, -1))?;
    Ok(())
}
